facts.value: This module is taught to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) standard. The beginner's module aims to provide the student with a strong basic knowledge of Spanish and of contemporary Spain and Latin America, particularly as regards the economic and commercial dimensions. The module is designed to enable the student to understand and use basic structures of Spanish grammar, expose the student to a range of vocabulary and expressions which will allow her/him to present her/himself to, and communicate with native speakers of Spanish, foster autonomous language learning skills, introduce the student to Spanish and Latin American cultures, develop listening and speaking skills in Spanish, and equip the student with basic writing skills.

This module is taught to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) standard to introduce students to Business Spanish relevant to their future professional needs, provide students with an understanding of key aspects of contemporary Spanish society, enable students to develop practical skills (receptive and active), and consolidate students' knowledge of Spanish vocabulary and grammar.
